compiled_state.title: T2: RED — Implement check-story-handoff.sh
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Goal
Create plugins/dso/scripts/check-story-handoff.sh that reads predecessor story verifier verdict and halts if not PASS.

## Files to Create
- plugins/dso/scripts/check-story-handoff.sh

## Interface
- Arguments: --predecessor-story-id=<id> [--verifier-json=<path>]
- Locates verifier JSON via ticket show output or explicit --verifier-json path
- Reads P1 field (schema_version=2) or overall_verdict (schema_version=1 shim)
- Exits 0 if PASS, 1 if FAIL/BLOCKED/INCONCLUSIVE (with JSON error), 2 if file absent or malformed

## Acceptance Criteria
- chmod +x plugins/dso/scripts/check-story-handoff.sh
- bash tests/scripts/test-check-story-handoff.sh exits 0 (all 6 cases GREEN)

## Testing Mode
RED (depends S3/T1)
